# The Hamta Homestay, Manali

> Premium mountain homestay in Manali, Himachal Pradesh, India. Daily stays, monthly stays and group stays with breakfast included and more meals cooked on request, free Wi-Fi, constant electricity, a cook and a cleaner, yoga and meditation, and Himalayan views.

Address: 15th Mile, Hallan-i, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175136, India
Website: https://www.hamta.in

## Rates (INR, per room, up to 2 guests)
- Daily, with breakfast included: 2,000 per night. With the full meal package: 2,500 (one guest) or 3,000 (two guests). Stays of 7 nights or more get 15% off. Heater electricity: 1,000 per day (3,000 per month for monthly stays), only if used. All taxes included. Peak dates (national holidays, busy weekends, last week of Dec, first week of Jan, first two weeks of Feb) cost more.
- Monthly, with breakfast included: 15,000 (one guest) or 20,000 (two guests). With the full meal package: 24,000 or 30,000.
- Same prices for guests from India and abroad.

## Pages
- https://www.hamta.in/stay : rooms and rates
- https://www.hamta.in/monthly-stay : monthly and remote work stays
- https://www.hamta.in/groups : groups, teams, students, travel agencies
- https://www.hamta.in/workation : 6 day, 5 night workation in Manali for teams, organisations, universities and remote workers (priced separately from standard stays, enquiry form on the page)
- https://www.hamta.in/menu : food menu
- https://www.hamta.in/handbook : guest handbook
- https://www.hamta.in/book : request a stay (request first, pay in advance on confirmation)

## Facts
- 8 rooms, each with a double bed (extra mattress for a third guest). Groups of 15 to 20 guests. 3 rooms are kept for monthly stays.
- Check-in from 12 PM, check-out 11 AM. Guests may arrive at any time at no extra charge.
- Cancellation: full refund 10 days before, 60% at 7 days, 30% at 3 days, none at 24 hours. Full refund if Hamta cannot provide room or food.
- Pets, children and unmarried couples welcome. No smoking. Alcohol accepted. Free parking, free laundry, kettles, balconies.
- Host: Kabir. WhatsApp and phone: +91 62398 15892. Email: hello@hamta.in
- Breakfast is included with every stay, with or without the full meal package.
